name: Reaction GIF
summary: A short looped clip from a film, a show or a sport, sent in place of a sentence. The frame is small, grainy and often carries a one-line caption in heavy white capitals.

philosophy.core_thesis: A looped second of a real face says a feeling faster than a sentence, so the clip is the reply.
design_principles: Loop a clip of 1 to 4 seconds at 10 to 15 fps with a seamless cut from the last frame to the first.
Export the frame at 480px wide or less in 256 colours, and let dithering and grain stay visible.
Set a caption in heavy white capitals with a 2px black outline, at 8% to 12% of the frame height.
Place the caption on the lower third of the frame, centred, with 4% margin from the edge.
Crop tight on one face or one gesture, so that the subject fills 50% to 70% of the frame.
Frame the clip in a 1px white outline on a dark card of #22222C when it shows inside a feed.
Show the search tag, for example #facepalm, in 12px capitals under the clip.
anti_patterns: Smooth 60 fps video with no dither
Long clips with a visible cut point
Wide landscape frames with a small subject
Clean studio gradients behind the clip

layout.grid_mechanics: A masonry wall of clips in 2 to 4 columns with 8px gutters; each cell keeps the aspect ratio of its clip.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 8 and 16px.
layout.alignment_rules: The caption is centred on the lower third; tags and source lines are flush-left under the clip.
layout.container_geometry: Clip cells with a 0px radius and a 2px white edge; a caption box has no fill.

font_pairings.note: Anton is an open look-alike of Impact; it takes the caption role.
A second open condensed face for captions.

hierarchy_rules: Set the caption in 1 size only, in capitals, in white with a black outline of 2px.
Set tags and source lines in 12px sans at 70% opacity.
Keep one caption for each clip, of 6 words or fewer.

color.palette_structure: Dark UI ground with white captions and one yellow and one blue highlight; the clip supplies the other colours.
color.contrast_rules: Caption white on the dark feed holds 16:1; on a clip, the black outline keeps the caption legible.
color.surface_treatment: Flat dark cards around the clip; the clip itself shows dither and compression grain.
color.light_and_shadow: No UI light; shadow comes only from the film still.

materiality.surface_simulation: Compressed film or TV footage: 256-colour dither, banding and visible block noise.
materiality.border_rules: A 2px white edge on a selected clip; no border otherwise.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Solid glyphs at 24px: heart, share, copy-link, search.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Film and sports stills, shown as loops; no drawn art.

motion.transition_physics: The clip loops without end at 10 to 15 fps; hover starts the clip, leave pauses it on the first frame.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover adds a 2px yellow edge; active copies the link and shows a 1s toast.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a quick shared reaction, funny and a little raw.

use_cases: social posts and newsletters with a joke
empty and success states with a human face
meme walls and tag search pages
avoid_when: The audience needs a serious or formal tone.
The source film has no rights for reuse.
The page must load fast on a weak network.

modifiers.how: Freeze all of the frame except one moving part and export at 24 fps with no caption.
Add a 2px to 8px channel split and 3 to 6 frame bursts of torn bands.
Replace the film still with a drawn character and a short hand-lettered word.

pack.why: A solid, rounded family fits the small action glyphs under a clip.

ground.why: The dither and compression grain of a looped clip read as a coarse dot field behind the page.

tailwind.classes: bg-[#14141A] text-[#FFFFFF] font-sans antialiased px-4 md:px-12
text-4xl md:text-6xl font-['Anton'] uppercase tracking-[0.02em] leading-[1.1]
rounded-none border-2 border-[#FFFFFF] bg-[#FFD60A] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-[#14141A] transition-transform duration-[100ms] hover:-translate-y-0.5
